explication: This repository equips Cursor, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot with agent instructions and standalone Python tools. The intended workflow is an IDE assistant planning a task, using web/search/LLM capabilities as needed, and learning from user corrections. The README also describes experimental planner–executor collaboration and screenshot verification. Tool implementations are sampled, but the instruction files and their wiring into IDEs are not; those relationships are shown only where documented.
